patch_list: Allow a resigned Peafowl build to launch by neutralizing its own signing-certificate check. Required because GMS_27.5.2 verifies its signature at startup. Experimental.
Use Peafowl's local free-theme path without the billing preflight. Experimental; server downloads are not guaranteed.
